name: godot_inspect
description: Ask THIS Godot what it really exposes, in one call: search (words found in class names and in the properties, methods with their signature and signals of every class of its ClassDB, and the project's script classes; ranked), a class (its inheritance, own properties with type, hint and default, methods with their real signatures, signals, enums, its documentation page; with match, the inherited members too), a live node of the open scene (class, script, instanced scene, children, groups, the property values that differ from the defaults, persistent connections, configuration warnings) and/or the open scene's tree. Entries beyond limit are named. Always says the Godot version and its documentation. Read only.

class.description: A class: Node3D, CharacterBody2D, or a project script class.

node.description: A node path in the open scene, relative to its root (Player/Camera3D).

match.description: Keep the members matching: a glob on names (collision_*), or words found in them.
